title: ISO-NE .Z.WCMASS: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-04, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: ISO-NE via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables isone_dam_zone_prices, isone_rtm_zone_prices; data retrieved to 2026-11-05.
citations: ISO New England (ISO-NE). Day-Ahead Energy Market Hourly LMPs. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `isone_dam_zone_prices`, ERW commit e2794ff06139.
ISO New England (ISO-NE). Real-Time Energy Market Five-Minute LMPs. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `isone_rtm_zone_prices`, ERW commit e2794ff06139.
facts: ISO-NE .Z.WCMASS, 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-04: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 22:00 local, 5.86 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 15:00, -13.17 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-04: 1.83 USD/MWh.
